operations.body: The five-cycle packet fixes exactly G_circle={G,singletons}, chooses n_e−1=4 extra facets, and tests nonempty expected-codimension intersection on the source polytope plus nondegeneracy. operations.title: Benincasa establishes source authorization of the five-cycle OFPT sum
operations.body: Entry 1249 closes the serialization gate. Entry 1199’s fixed G+singletons is exactly G_circle in arXiv:2112.09028 Eq. (33); its four extra facets are n_e−1; and its nonempty expected-codimension source-face test is exactly the compatible G_c predicate, with rank-ten nondegeneracy.
